About

One person.
A few good tools.

I'm Florin. I build software I want to use myself, then keep polishing it until it feels quiet and obvious. florinworks is where those projects live.

  • 01

    Your files stay yours

    Plain formats, saved on your own machine. No accounts unless they're truly needed.

  • 02

    Native where it counts

    Real file dialogs, real shortcuts, at home on Mac and on Windows.

  • 03

    Finished, not featureful

    Fewer things, done properly. Every detail gets a second look.
